1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const width = canvas.width;
12:   const height = canvas.height;
13: 
14:   // Audio setup
15:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
16:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
17:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
18:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
19:     osc.type = 'sine';
20:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
21:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
23:     osc.start();
24:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
25:   }
26: 
27:   // Background stars
28:   const stars = [];
29:   const starCount = 80;
30:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
31:     stars.push({
32:       x: Math.random() * width,
33:       y: Math.random() * height,
34:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
35:     });
36:   }
37: 
38:   // Ship
39:   const ship = {
40:     x: width / 2,
41:     y: height - 40,
42:     radius: 12,
43:     speed: 4,
44:     dx: 0,
45:     dy: 0,
46:     draw() {
47:       // Gradient ship body
48:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x - this.radius, this.y - this.radius, this.x + this.radius, this.y + this.radius);
49:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
50:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
51:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
52:       ctx.beginPath();
53:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y - this.radius);
54:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.radius, this.y + this.radius);
55:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.radius, this.y + this.radius);
56:       ctx.closePath();
57:       ctx.fill();
58:     }
59:   };
60: 
61:   // Asteroids
62:   const asteroids = [];
63:   const asteroidSettings = {
64:     minSize: 10,
65:     maxSize: 30,
66:     speedRange: [2, 5],
67:     spawnInterval: 1000 // ms
68:   };
69: 
70:   let lastSpawn = 0;
71:   let startTime = null;
72:   let gameOver = false;
73:   let score = 0;
74: 
75:   function spawnAsteroid() {
76:     const size = Math.random() * (asteroidSettings.maxSize - asteroidSettings.minSize) + asteroidSettings.minSize;
77:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size * 2) + size;
78:     const y = -size;
79:     const speed = Math.random() * (asteroidSettings.speedRange[1] - asteroidSettings.speedRange[0]) + asteroidSettings.speedRange[0];
80:     asteroids.push({ x, y, r: size, speed });
81:     // subtle spawn sound
82:     playBeep(150, 0.05);
83:   }
84: 
85:   function update(delta) {
86:     // Move ship
87:     ship.x += ship.dx;
88:     ship.y += ship.dy;
89:     // Keep within bounds
90:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(width - ship.radius, ship.x));
91:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(height - ship.radius, ship.y));
92: 
93:     // Move stars (parallax effect)
94:     for (const s of stars) {
95:       s.y += 0.5; // slow downwards drift
96:       if (s.y > height) {
97:         s.y = 0;
98:         s.x = Math.random() * width;
99:       }
100:     }
101: 
102:     // Move asteroids
103:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
104:       const a = asteroids[i];
105:       a.y += a.speed;
106:       // Remove off-screen
107:       if (a.y - a.r > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
108:     }
109: 
110:     // Collision detection
111:     for (const a of asteroids) {
112:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
113:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
114:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
115:       if (dist < a.r + ship.radius) {
116:         // collision sound
117:         playBeep(300, 0.2);
118:         gameOver = true;
119:         break;
120:       }
121:     }
122: 
123:     // Score based on survival time
124:     if (!gameOver && startTime !== null) {
125:       score = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(2);
126:     }
127:   }
128: 
129:   function draw() {
130:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
131:     // Draw background stars
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
133:     for (const s of stars) {
134:       ctx.beginPath();
135:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
136:       ctx.fill();
137:     }
138:     // Draw ship
139:     ship.draw();
140:     // Draw asteroids with gradient
141:     for (const a of asteroids) {
142:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.r);
143:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff7777');
144:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#aa0000');
145:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
146:       ctx.beginPath();
147:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
148:       ctx.fill();
149:       // subtle stroke
150:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
151:       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
152:       ctx.stroke();
153:     }
154:     // Draw score
155:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
156:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
157:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, 10, 20);
158:     if (gameOver) {
159:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
160:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
161:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
162:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
163:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
164:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2 - 10);
165:       ctx.font = '18px monospace';
166:       ctx.fillText(`Survived: ${score}s`, width / 2, height / 2 + 20);
167:     }
168:   }
169: 
170:   function loop(timestamp) {
171:     if (!startTime) startTime = Date.now();
172:     const delta = timestamp - (lastFrame || timestamp);
173:     lastFrame = timestamp;
174: 
175:     if (!gameOver) {
176:       if (timestamp - lastSpawn > asteroidSettings.spawnInterval) {
177:         spawnAsteroid();
178:         lastSpawn = timestamp;
179:       }
180:       update(delta);
181:     }
182:     draw();
183:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
184:   }
185: 
186:   // Keyboard handling
187:   const keys = {};
188:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
189:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.dx = -ship.speed;
190:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.dx = ship.speed;
191:     if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') ship.dy = -ship.speed;
192:     if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') ship.dy = ship.speed;
193:   });
194:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
195:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.dx = 0;
196:     if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') ship.dy = 0;
197:   });
198: 
199:   // Start the game loop
200:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
201: })();
